title: rubus silvaticus subsp. leyi
intro: Rubus silvaticus subsp. leyi, commonly known as the woodland bramble, is a subspecies of the Rubus silvaticus plant, belonging to the Rosaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of woodland bramble include wound healing, anti-aging, and immune system support. Its bioactive constituents include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and may provide protection against chronic diseases.
